system.name: CrewAI
system.version: crewai 1.15.2, sequential crew (SQL Analyst + Query Validator)

declarations.artifacts: runs/crewai_run{1,2,3}.jsonl and runs/crewai_run{1,2,3}_score/ (organizer-side; per-task SQL, verdict, latency, token counts and cost for all three runs)
declarations.notes: Single-turn only: the 41 tier-9 multi-turn turns were not attempted and are scored as failures, which is why execution accuracy over the 190-task denominator sits far below the single-turn subset figure of 67.1%. All three runs answered 149/149 with no refusal and no SQL error. MODEL CONFIGURATION DIFFERS FROM THE LANGCHAIN ROW: gpt-5.6-luna is a reasoning model, and OpenAI rejects function tools alongside reasoning on /v1/chat/completions. The LangChain arm keeps reasoning by using the Responses API; CrewAI 1.15.2's Responses support is single-turn only and cannot carry a tool loop, so this arm runs with reasoning_effort='none' via CrewAI's supported additional_params passthrough. Both arms are otherwise identical -- same 149 task ids, same grounding string, same schema, same read-only snapshot, same runner, same scorer -- but the reasoning difference means this row is not a clean scaffold-only comparison with the LangChain row. Token counts are exact crew usage metrics, not estimates.
